set.body:
Acceptance criteria
- One shared pure planner normalizes axes and negative starts for owned, borrowed, and mutable narrow.
- length must be nonnegative and endpoint arithmetic is checked before narrowing to Int.
- narrow(0,-1,1), narrow(0,-5,5), narrow(0,5,0), narrow(0,5,1), narrow(0,-6,1), and narrow(0,0,-1) match the documented contract for extent five.
- Int.MinValue, Int.MaxValue, zero extents, negative axes, and composed views have explicit tests.
- Generated operation-sequence tests compare narrow and subsequent views with a slow logical Vector model.
- JVM and Scala.js suites pass.
set.title: Specify and implement checked exact narrow semantics
